customers.evidence: starting with those who take our medicines

employees.evidence: We maintain an environment built on mutual respect, openness and individual integrity.

dei.evidence: Respect for People includes our concern for all people who touch or are touched by our company

community.evidence: We will make a significant contribution to humanity by improving global health in the 21st century.

shareholders.evidence: strive to deliver superior business results

integrity.evidence: We conduct our business consistent with all applicable laws and are honest in our dealings with customers

innovation.evidence: We pursue pharmaceutical innovation, provide high quality products

result.analyst_notes: Heritage-framed and values-led, with absolute first-person plural commitments ('We conduct', 'We pursue') and aspirational vision language. Integrity is the headline core value. Customers, then employees and communities are addressed first. Patient focus and humanity-wide health language are distinctive; wording is mostly declarative rather than hedged.
